"''All batteries, open fire.|The Imperial weapons technician and Kassius Konstantine|audio=KonstantineOpenFire-ZeroHour.flac|}} An '''Imperial weapons technician''' served aboard [[Kassius Konstantine's Interdictor]] during the [[Battle of Atollon]]. During the battle, the [[Imperial weapons technician|weapons technician]] was stationed on the [[Interdictor-class heavy cruiser|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser's]] [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] and informed its [[commanding officer]], [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine]], that the [[gravity well projector]] were engaged. Konstantine then ordered the [[technician]] to open fire on all batteries. Later in the battle, the [[Interdictor]] was destroyed after being [[Ramming|rammed]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|ship]] ''[[Phoenix Nest]]''. ==Behind the scenes== The weapons technician appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[Zero Hour]]," the finale of the series' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]]. The episode was released on [[March 25]], [[2017]] over two parts, the twenty-first and twenty-second episodes of the season overall.{{InsiderCite|174|Star Wars Rebels Season Three Episode Guide|''Star Wars Rebels'' Season Three Episode Guide}} They were not credited in the episode. ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Zero Hour}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Seventh Fleet personnel]]
